source_lines.text: Laying in the sofa,.... Dhika was watching songs when she heard the door bell.....
Ding Dong.....
Not expecting John already, she curiously stepped towards the door and when she saw through the peep hole, she couldn't see anyone.....
With a little caution, Dhika opened the door to peek outside........
Just as she opened the door, she saw an Amazon delivery person leaving down the stairs. It was usual for Amazon delivery person to leave the parcel infront of the house and leave without waiting.
She wondered if John had ordered something and picked the parcel into the house......
Closing the door, she came to the sofa with the box to examine what it was.
It was a fairly large box, gift wrapped, with a small card attached to it.
There was no sender name or address, but had a small card which said only three words............
" Hello Beautiful...
~ Stranger "
Dhika: Stranger ?? who could that be.... did they deliver to wrong address
Dhika checked and the To address was to her indeed....
Without waiting anymore, Dhika ripped the wrap and opened the box.....
She had no clue who had sent it, but what was inside made her mouth smile wide.......
Dhika: Little heartsss......

There were so many big packets of Little hearts biscuits, which were her favorite.... and by now she was a little sure that this was John's work, because only he and her parents know it was her favorite....
John: you ordered biscuits from Amazon ??
Dhika: me ?? I thought you did...... and why did you gift wrap it.....
John: what ? ... I did not order anything dear......
Dhika: what ? John it came with this card, and I thought it was you playing with me...... she looked a little worried
John looked at the note from the card,... and both blinked at each other, but before they could talk anything else, Leo came outside wearing John's cloths and the towel in his hand.......
Standing in the kitchen, she saw the box of Little Hearts laying the corner.....
Dhika: Johnnn...... she shouted
John: startled,.... what, what happened ???
Dhika: we almost forgot about this gift.......
John: pheff... I thought someone came to rob us..... he gave her a stern look.....
Dhika: don't play John. Someone has sent this, and I have no idea who.....
John: Could it be the twins ?
Asking it, John gave her a naughty little grin before turning back.......
Seeing the grin on his face, Dhika suddenly remembered about the questions that John had asked her last time in bed, and the blood rushed to her cheeks.....
Dhika: Twins ? no,.... no,... could not be........
John: are you sure ....... he teased her with more grin......
John knew not to tease her too much with the twins or else she may curl back into her cave not long before..... So, he made sure to thread the topic of twins very carefully.....
Dhika did not really heed to what John said later, but rather, her thoughts were about what John said earlier.....
Dhika: It could be Bantu..... ! but why would be mention as stranger ??
She wasn't sure, yet she reminded herself to check with the twins later......

source_lines.text: Dhika knew this bathroom mess at their house was going to happen sooner or later...
John, Dhika and Pappu were having a nice evening at John's parents' house when suddenly, they got a call from Uncle...
Their bathroom had broken again, and water was spilling all over,....
Good thing Uncle noticed water leaking outside their main door, and upon checking, he had switched the main water line to their house...
Now, back at their house, Uncle and plumber Iroh were looking at the damages, while Dhika and John were packing John's bags, who was travelling back to Pune...
Dhika: You had to go now,... leaving me in this total mess ?
John: I am so sorry dear,.. I have to go... but, you have Uncle to look after them,.. he insisted that he wanted too....
Dhika: Yeah,.. again burden for him,... atleast, this time, I could be around to lend help,.. when I am not at college....
John: No need to worry about that,... thanks to Uncle, Iroh and his two workmen agreed to stay at our house itself for next 3 days to finish up all the work...
Initially, John thought about getting the bathroom fixed as soon as possible, but that's what they did last time too, and then it was broken again.

So, this time, he thought better of it and decided to make over the entire bathroom,... to lay up new fitting, a bathtub and new piping...... but the time and effort needed couldn't be covered in three days, and it was no where possible unless they worked day and night...
John was persistent on finishing it up in three days,... because on the fourth day, it was Pappu's birthday, and he had something special in his mind...
And at last, with Uncle's help, John convinced and the workmen agreed...
They would be staying at John's place itself, and split the work among them, working day and night...
Finalizing the plan, John paid an advance to Iroh, and Uncle left to send them off.......

source_lines.text: When she gave the open door a knock, an old man popped out from her bathroom.
Iroh: Ah ! Dhika madam,... please come in.
Dhika: Hi,... she smiled.
The first thing that fell on Dhika's eyes was his smile.....She didn't know why, but it felt so,... warming.
Dhika: I know, I am a day early, but....
Iroh: Oh no,.. you arrived at the perfect time madam...
Dhika: Oh, please call me Dhika. She smiled.
Dhika: I am almost your daughter's age. You should call me by my name.
Iroh: haha.. okay Dhika. I was about to call you today, but then you came yourself.
Dhika: What happened ?
Iroh: The bath tub that you wanted,... the dealer called.
Iroh: He said they ran out of stock, and it would take atleast a month or two to get the same one..
Dhika: Ohhhh,...
Iroh: Yeah, I called and informed John sir yesterday itself. He said to finish the rest for now. Please come with me.
As he led the way, Dhika followed him behind like a little duckling....
Dhika placed Iroh to be around 56 - 57, about 5 years younger than Uncle, but he was a lot shorter and a lot fatter.
Dhika was a decent 5'6'', but Iroh was merely 5 feet and he had a round pot like belly which jiggled whenever he spoke laughing,..... and nicely groomed beard.
Something about his laughing face and jiggling belly felt very warming to Dhika, and he was indeed very respectful and soft spoken.
Iroh: Smiling, we have finished laying the new tiles, the pipes and the big shower head.... and this new sink.
Iroh: Only thing pending is the bathtub, which we will setup once is it available.
Unlike Iroh, this one was very tall, about 6 feet high, very young,.... and had a hairless, spotless face.
And just like Iroh, he too had a smiling face, but it felt more like,.... charming.
Iroh: haha,.... he is like that,.... a very radiant boy.
Iroh: He is always short and precise. Read hard worker.
When Dhika and Iroh came back to the hall, Iroh started packing his stuff,... and Dhika settled on a dining chair, and began asking him about his whereabouts and family.
And whenever he spoke, Dhika noticed Iroh looking straight into her eyes,....... and for Dhika, it felt as if he was trying to read her.
As their talk progressed, Iroh traversed from regular talk to making innocent jokes, taking much effort to make Dhika smile.... and Dhika wondered why he was doing so...
Iroh: Do you know what brightens the day? A good cup of tea.
Dhika: Oh, yes.... Sorry, let me prepare.
Iroh: Please, let me... I love brewing a good soothing tea for others.
Despite her efforts, Iroh wouldn't budge,... and hence, leaving him to prepare tea,... Dhika went to grab plates to set snacks for them.

Dhika was wearing a cute little top,... and soggy pants. Though the top was little, it showed no cleavage or any hints of the fact that she wasn't wearing a bra underneath,... but when she raised herself up to pick plates from the cupboard, and when she sat down, both the times the top raised significantly higher,..... exposing her entire midriff and her little slender waist came into Iroh's view,... and one could easily see her cute little buttonhole of a navel. ~~
Dhika: I... could have worn a bigger T shirt... she blushed
Though multiple times Dhika saw Iroh's eyes come and go past her,... not once he made an attempt to steal a glance at her exposed skin.

Not that Dhika never enjoyed her favourite ones taking a peek at her...... she was indeed turning into quite an exhibitionist,..... but at the moment, with her current state of mind, It felt good that Iroh was not ogling at her at all.... and that made a good valued impression of him in her heart.
Dhika: Woo... this tea is soo gooood.
Iroh: haha, thank you Dhika,.... the secret is in slow brewing.
Dhika: Your wife must be very lucky.
Iroh: Smiling a little..... She passed away at an young age Dhika.
Dhika: ohhh !!!.... I am,... soo sorry.
Iroh: Its okay. It has been very long.

Dhika asked a few more things about his wife as they both sipped their teas,....... and Iroh kept looking deep into Dhika's eyes,... and soon, it made Dhika wonder if her troubled mind was so readable in her eyes....
She recalled that Iroh had been reading her eyes for quite some time now,... and he even tried to make her laugh.
Dhika wondered if he knew that she was sad....
And immediately, she got the answer.
Iroh: Dhika,... I am not sure what is troubling you, but I can say one thing which I always believed in.
Dhika: Hmmm... she smiled feebly, feeling uncomfortable.
Dhika wasn't ready to open up her life to some stranger, whom she barely knew.... and he doesn't even know what was happening in her life.
And definitely wasn't interested in hearing advice from yet another older person.... but nevertheless, he started.
Iroh: Living life to its fullest is not a bad thing.
But when those left his mouth,... it wasn't what Dhika had expected to hear.
Iroh: As long as what you do does not hurt others, how you live your life is up to you Dhika.
And before she knew,... he finished.... and moved to clear the plates and his cup.
As Dhika sat there quietly, the two lines which Iroh said kept repeating in her mind again and again.
While she expected some regular old generation's this is right and this is wrong - sort of advice, Iroh had said something entirely unexpected,.......
To add, what Iroh said was very simply, and short, and Dhika felt as if he said those words, knowing exactly what was troubling her.
As she sat there thinking on what Iroh said,.... a moment of realisation hit Dhika.
Dhika: Yeah,... he is right !
Dhika: I didn't hurt anyone... not myself, not Bantu,... not,... John.
Dhika: John,... he.....
And it hit her that John would probably get excited knowing what had happened,...and realizing it, Dhika couldn't help but let out a soft giggle,....
Dhika: Smiling,.... Thank you,... Ir*...
She couldn't finish herself to call him Iroh.... it didn't feel right,...
And then, coincidentally, just then another hoarse voice entered the picture.
Zuko: Uncle Iroh,.... I bought the gift you asked for.
Zuko stormed into the hall announcing his arrival to Iroh,,... and when he sensed the presence of one more body in the vicinity,... his legs froze.

And as he raised his head slowly,.. the first thing that his eyes caught were the milky white hips of Dhika, exposed in contrast to her dark colored pants,... and just as he realised what he was seeing, Zuko immediately averted his eyes and looked up..... only to see Dhika watching him intently,.. with a smile on her face,... and eyebrows raised in wonder.....
Zuko: I will... I will put this in the bathroom.....
Saying,... he rushed inside carrying a small plant in a cute little pot.
Zuko always seemed so tensed in Dhika's eyes.

Even when she met him for the first time, he did not look her in her eyes,...and had a very serious face,.... and now too even though he was only talking with Iroh when he entered in, Dhika felt as if he was still in that same serious state,...
She wondered why he was so.
Iroh: The bathroom would look wonderful with that little croton.
Dhika: Oh, you should not have bought it Ir*,....
Again she stopped herself from calling him by his name,....... but then how Zuko call him crossed her mind.
Dhika: Uncle Iroh. Can I call you Uncle Iroh ?
Iroh: haha,.. yes.
Iroh: About that plant. I always gift a plant when my service is done. Hope you don't mind.
Dhika: Mind, ofcourse not. But you didn't have to gift us one.
Iroh smiled,... and offered to pour some more tea for Dhika....
As she continued to sip the tea, waiting to see Zuko come out,....... he did not return.
Dhika: Uncle,... do you mind if I ask,... why Zuko always seem so serious ?
Iroh: He,... uhnnn,.....
Dhika: He seem troubled,...
Iroh: He is Dhika,... he had a.....
Dhika: oh,,..... sorry, I shouldn't pry....
Iroh: He had a,... very struggling past Dhika,...
Iroh: But, it is in the past now,.... He is doing his best to find himself again.
Iroh: He is a good kid.
Iroh did not say what that troubled past was,... and though Dhika wished to know what happened, she did not ask.
Soon, finishing her tea,... Dhika stood up to pay the settlement to Uncle Iroh,..... and thanking him for both the service and advice,... she bid him thank you and Goodbye.
And no sooner than Uncle stepped out of the door,... Zuko rushed out from nowhere,... and just with a curt nod at Dhika,... he ran down the stairs.
Dhika: Watching in pity,... will he be alright, Uncle Iroh ?
Iroh: He will be,... he just need to find his path again.
Dhika: I hope he does. Take care Uncle Iroh. Thank you once again.
Iroh: Thank you Dhika. You too take care.

source_lines.text: Dhika knew this bathroom mess at their house was going to happen sooner or later...
John, Dhika and Pappu were having a nice evening at John's parents' house when suddenly, they got a call from Uncle...
Their bathroom had broken again, and water was spilling all over,....
Good thing Uncle noticed water leaking outside their main door, and upon checking, he had switched the main water line to their house...
Now, back at their house, Uncle and plumber Iroh were looking at the damages, while Dhika and John were packing John's bags, who was travelling back to Pune...
Dhika: You had to go now,... leaving me in this total mess ?
John: I am so sorry dear,.. I have to go... but, you have Uncle to look after them,.. he insisted that he wanted too....
Dhika: Yeah,.. again burden for him,... atleast, this time, I could be around to lend help,.. when I am not at college....
John: No need to worry about that,... thanks to Uncle, Iroh and his two workmen agreed to stay at our house itself for next 3 days to finish up all the work...
Initially, John thought about getting the bathroom fixed as soon as possible, but that's what they did last time too, and then it was broken again.

So, this time, he thought better of it and decided to make over the entire bathroom,... to lay up new fitting, a bathtub and new piping...... but the time and effort needed couldn't be covered in three days, and it was no where possible unless they worked day and night...
John was persistent on finishing it up in three days,... because on the fourth day, it was Pappu's birthday, and he had something special in his mind...
And at last, with Uncle's help, John convinced and the workmen agreed...
They would be staying at John's place itself, and split the work among them, working day and night...
Finalizing the plan, John paid an advance to Iroh, and Uncle left to send them off.......
